material_result: A frozen aligned k-dimensional basis stays near oracle under the printed within-span Q@R rotation, while adaptive Oja becomes useful when the ambient subspace truly rotates. Under explicit ambient drift, generic EW-PCA matches or exceeds Oja at larger angles, so adaptive subspace tracking is supported but Oja-specific computational superiority is not established.
